scope: Knowledge circulation and access; search/GEO; publisher and data economics; multilingual coverage; censorship versus technical access barriers.
write_boundary: Only this research packet. No canonical data, code, generated Atlas assets, logs or commits changed.

method: Read parent CLAUDE.md and zhet/BIBLE.md; no repository-local AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md was found by file inventory.
Read the Atlas README and the prior knowledge-gatekeeping packet README before primary-source research.
Audited knowledge/access events and their sources, then searched every string in the canonical JSON for candidate names, paper identifiers and URL families.

Dedup operates on events, study/programme families and normalized URLs, not just proposed IDs. URL normalization removes tracking parameters, fragments and trailing slashes; arXiv abs/html/pdf and version variants collapse to one paper family.
Existing records were used as a novelty baseline, not as external proof. The historical corpus was not globally fact-checked in this task.
Independent research strands used batched web queries. No additional chat or subagent was created; no parallel-agent tool was available in this session.

selection.summary_ru: Четыре кандидата по окончательному лимиту пользователя: экономика открытого источника, исследование поисковых переходов, международная проверка новостных ответов и открыто лицензированный корпус. FineWeb2 и R1dacted сохранены отдельно как резерв, не рекомендации к текущему включению.
selection.summary_en: Four candidates in this bounded pass: open-source economics, a search-referral study, an international news-answer audit and an openly licensed corpus. FineWeb2 and R1dacted are retained separately as reserve material, not recommended for this integration.
selection.integration_rule: Use one record per family below. Related milestones and source variants are supporting material, not additional independent evidence counts.

candidates.date_basis: Public financial-report disclosure and audit-file upload, not revenue accrual date. Fiscal period: 2024-07-01 through 2025-06-30; auditor opinion dated 2025-09-30. The blog also displays an update dated 2026-11-04; the original audit PDF independently anchors the figures.
candidates.title_ru: Wikimedia Enterprise: доход от сервиса при свободном доступе к контенту
candidates.title_en: Wikimedia Enterprise: service revenue alongside freely accessible content
candidates.summary_ru: Аудит за FY2024-25 фиксирует $8,297,917 признанной выручки Enterprise и $7,467,500 денежных поступлений. Платный продукт предоставляет API и сервисные гарантии, а не исключительное владение знаниями Wikipedia.
candidates.summary_en: The FY2024-25 audit records $8,297,917 in recognized Enterprise revenue and $7,467,500 in cash collected. The paid offering supplies APIs and service guarantees, not exclusive ownership of Wikipedia knowledge.
candidates.caveat_ru: Это не оценка всего рынка лицензирования и не выручка исключительно от ИИ. Не приписывать январским партнёрам 2026 года платежи предыдущего финансового года.
candidates.caveat_en: This is neither the whole licensing market nor AI-only revenue. Do not attribute prior-fiscal-year payments to partners announced in January 2026.

numbers.source_locator: Audit, printed page 10, note 1(o); revenue also on printed page 4.

candidates.structural_power_inference: Paid infrastructure can fund an open knowledge supplier without granting exclusive content or editorial control. Supplier bargaining power and long-run financial independence are not measured by the revenue total.

sources.title: Wikimedia Foundation, Inc. Consolidated Financial Statements, June 30, 2025 and 2024
sources.date_basis: Independent auditor report date; public file uploaded 2025-11-24.
sources.verification: Opened the official PDF and checked note 1(o), including the cash/revenue distinction.

sources.title: Wikimedia Enterprise Financial Report: Fiscal Year 2024 - 2025
sources.verification: Read financial narrative, fiscal-period footnote and link to the audit.

sources.title: Wikimedia Enterprise/Principles
sources.date_basis: Last-edited date of inspected revision 30178240, not policy inception.
sources.verification: Checked free-use, non-exclusivity and no-editorial-influence provisions.

sources.title: Announcing New Wikimedia Enterprise Partners for Wikipedia's 25th Birthday
sources.verification: Explicit date and named users; agreements were formalized over the preceding year, not necessarily signed on announcement day.

related_milestone.detail: Amazon, Meta, Microsoft, Mistral AI and Perplexity were publicly named as Enterprise partners. Individual terms and payments were not disclosed.

counterevidence.claim_ru: Принципы Enterprise сохраняют бесплатное использование и запрещают эксклюзивные договоры и влияние клиентов на редактуру.
counterevidence.claim_en: Enterprise principles preserve free reuse and prohibit exclusive contracts and customer editorial influence.
counterevidence.implication: Counterexample to treating every paid data relationship as enclosure or supplier capture.

dedup.reason: No Enterprise financial result or API-service economics family exists. News Corp is a different deal; Microsoft Marketplace is a different programme; the Wikimedia agent investigation is an unrelated incident.

candidates.date_basis: First preprint submission. All retained estimates are from v7, dated 2026-10-25, using December 2023-December 2024 observations. Neither the data window nor the latest revision is silently substituted for first publication.
candidates.title_ru: Wikipedia: новая версия исследования оценивает снижение поисковых переходов примерно на 5%
candidates.title_en: Wikipedia: revised study estimates roughly 5% lower search referrals
candidates.summary_ru: Модель difference-in-differences оценивает снижение поисковых переходов к английским статьям на 5,45% относительно немецких и 4,82% относительно французских после внедрения AI Overviews в США.
candidates.summary_en: A difference-in-differences model estimates English-article search referrals falling 5.45% relative to German and 4.82% relative to French after the US AI Overviews rollout.
candidates.caveat_ru: Препринт, не рандомизированный эксперимент; вывод зависит от сопоставимости трендов и языкового приближения экспозиции. Это не весь трафик и не измеренная потеря выручки. Версия v2 была отозвана.
candidates.caveat_en: A preprint, not a randomized trial; inference depends on parallel trends and language-based exposure proxies. This is not total traffic or measured revenue loss. Version v2 was withdrawn.
candidates.structural_power_inference: Attention reallocation is estimated. Publisher bargaining power, content-supply collapse and monetary losses are downstream hypotheses, not observed outcomes here.

sources.title: Impact of AI Search Summaries on Website Traffic: Evidence from Google AI Overviews and Wikipedia
sources.publisher: Mehrzad Khosravi and Hema Yoganarasimhan / arXiv
sources.verification: Opened current submission history and v7 full text, including design, robustness and monetization sections.

sources.title: Impact of AI Search Summaries on Website Traffic: withdrawn version 2
sources.publisher: Mehrzad Khosravi and Hema Yoganarasimhan / arXiv
sources.verification: Explicit withdrawal notice. Historical 15% estimate is not retained as the current result.

sources.title: New user trends on Wikipedia
sources.verification: Read operator account of traffic reclassification and its explicitly interpretive attribution.

counterevidence.claim_ru: Wikimedia предупреждает, что пересмотр детекции ботов меняет сравнимость человеческих просмотров; влияние ИИ и социальных платформ в её сообщении является интерпретацией.
counterevidence.claim_en: Wikimedia warns that revised bot detection changes human-pageview comparability; its attribution to AI and social platforms is interpretive.
counterevidence.implication: Do not combine operator-wide pageview changes with this study's search-referral effect or treat them as independent causal replications.

dedup.reason: Pew tracks user click behavior; this family estimates publisher-side referrals from a different dataset and design. All seven versions and commentary on the same paper count as one family.

candidates.date_basis: International report launch. Responses were generated 2025-05-24 through 2025-06-10; the release date is not a test date. Earlier BBC-only work belongs to this study family.
candidates.title_ru: BBC/EBU: международная проверка выявила ошибки источников в новостных ответах
candidates.title_en: BBC/EBU: international audit finds sourcing failures in news answers
candidates.summary_ru: Проверка четырёх ассистентов на 14 языках в 18 странах выявила существенные проблемы в 45% ответов на основные вопросы; показатель проблем с источниками составил 31%.
candidates.summary_en: An audit of four assistants across 14 languages and 18 countries found significant issues in 45% of core-question answers; the sourcing-problem measure was 31%.
candidates.caveat_ru: Основная выборка: 2709 ответов; ещё 353 ответа относятся к дополнительным вопросам. Журналисты оценивали заданные запросы с предпочтением источников своей организации. Это не частота ошибок всего использования ИИ и не доказательство цензуры.
candidates.caveat_en: The core sample contains 2,709 answers; another 353 address custom questions. Journalists rated specified prompts favoring their organization's sources. This is not an all-use AI error rate or proof of censorship.
candidates.structural_power_inference: Answer interfaces mediate source attribution, but this audit does not measure intentional suppression, political control or publisher revenue.

sources.title: Largest study of its kind shows AI assistants misrepresent news content 45% of the time - regardless of language or territory
sources.verification: Dated launch release and named participating organizations; the broad headline is narrowed to the report's actual sample.

sources.title: News Integrity in AI Assistants: An international PSM study
sources.date_basis: Report cover month; exact launch day supplied by EBU's release.
sources.verification: Read methods on printed pages 63-65, denominators, sourcing definition and BBC-only comparison on page 19.

counterevidence.claim_ru: В сравнении только BBC доля существенных проблем снизилась с 51% до 37%; разные раунды не являются полностью одинаковым тестом.
counterevidence.claim_en: The BBC-only comparison fell from 51% to 37% with significant issues; the rounds are not identical tests.
counterevidence.implication: Retain improvement alongside failures; neither 45% nor any provider ranking is a November 2026 performance estimate.

dedup.reason: No BBC/EBU audit exists. This measures attribution/accuracy, not outlet preference, interface differences or fabricated-concept uptake. Do not add the earlier BBC round as another independent family.

candidates.date_basis: First arXiv publication describing released corpus and models; official project announcement followed on June 6. NeurIPS proceedings are a later publication of the same study.
candidates.title_ru: Common Pile: обучение на открыто лицензированных данных проверено на моделях 7B
candidates.title_en: Common Pile: openly licensed training data tested with 7B models
candidates.summary_ru: Common Pile объединил около 8 ТБ текстов из 30 источников. Две модели Comma 7B на его данных показали сопоставимые с Llama 1/2 7B результаты при близких вычислительных бюджетах.
candidates.summary_en: Common Pile assembled about 8 TB of text from 30 sources. Two Comma 7B models trained on it performed competitively with Llama 1/2 7B at similar compute budgets.
candidates.caveat_ru: Преимущественно английский корпус и ограниченный масштаб сравнения. Это не паритет с frontier-моделями 2026 года, не отмена стоимости обучения и не универсальное юридическое заключение о каждом документе.
candidates.caveat_en: Predominantly English, with a limited comparison scale. This is not parity with 2026 frontier models, removal of training costs or a universal legal ruling on every document.
candidates.structural_power_inference: A reproducible alternative weakens the claim that competitive smaller models necessarily require private publisher deals. It does not establish independence from compute or distribution providers.

sources.title: The Common Pile v0.1: An 8TB Dataset of Public Domain and Openly Licensed Text
sources.verification: Submission date, full text, comparison scale and English filtering checked.

sources.title: Common Pile v0.1 (NeurIPS 2025 proceedings entry)
sources.date_basis: NeurIPS 2025 proceedings year; exact posting date not asserted.
sources.verification: Official proceedings entry opened; same study, not independent replication.

sources.title: Common Pile: official datasets, models and code
sources.date_basis: Living artifact index inspected at cutoff; it displays a June 6, 2025 announcement.
sources.verification: Official inventory links raw data, training mixture, checkpoints and collection code.

counterevidence.claim_ru: Сам результат является контрдоказательством необходимости закрытого лицензирования для каждого конкурентоспособного корпуса; английский фокус ограничивает его многоязычную применимость.
counterevidence.claim_en: The result counters the necessity of closed licensing for every competitive corpus; its English focus limits multilingual applicability.
counterevidence.implication: Show as a bounded open alternative, not the disappearance of all data-access constraints.

dedup.reason: Legal doctrine and openness definitions are not a released, trained-and-evaluated corpus. Common Pile, Comma checkpoints and the NeurIPS paper are one family.

pending_candidates.pending_reason: Reserve outside the four-candidate shortlist. Primary text and artifact verified; conference-status verification remained blocked. Do not integrate automatically.
pending_candidates.date_basis: First research-paper publication, not first dataset launch. An author-team community post already discussed FineWeb2 on 2024-12-23. The paper's crawl window ends in April 2024.
pending_candidates.title_ru: FineWeb2: широкий языковой охват не означает равную глубину данных
pending_candidates.title_en: FineWeb2: broad language coverage does not imply equal data depth
pending_candidates.summary_ru: Исследование описывает адаптивную обработку Common Crawl: 20 ТБ и 1868 пар язык-письменность. Только 203 пары имеют не менее 10 тысяч документов.
pending_candidates.summary_en: The study describes adaptive Common Crawl processing: 20 TB across 1,868 language-script pairs. Only 203 pairs have at least 10,000 documents.
pending_candidates.caveat_ru: Это состав корпуса, не качество ответов на всех языках. Авторы отмечают узкий набор источников для многих малоресурсных языков; классификатор может путать близкие языки. Пропуски не доказывают цензуру.
pending_candidates.caveat_en: This is corpus coverage, not answer quality in every language. The authors report narrow sources for many low-resource languages; identification can confuse related languages. Missing coverage is not proof of censorship.
pending_candidates.structural_power_inference: Representation depends partly on upstream collection and curation, not only provider output rules. A multilingual label alone cannot establish equal epistemic access.

sources.title: FineWeb2: One Pipeline to Scale Them All -- Adapting Pre-Training Data Processing to Every Language
sources.verification: Read sections 5-6, including language-script counts, uneven volume and limitations.

sources.title: HuggingFaceFW/fineweb-2 dataset card
sources.date_basis: Living dataset card; no publication day invented.
sources.verification: Checked language-identification limitations and licensing section; dataset licensing is not treated as proof of every source document's copyright status.

sources.title: FineWeb2-C: Help Build Better Language Models in Your Language
sources.verification: Dated author-team post establishes that FineWeb2 predates the June 2025 paper.

counterevidence.claim_ru: Открытые данные и код дают возможность пересматривать фильтрацию; это техническая альтернатива, а не неизменный языковой барьер.
counterevidence.claim_en: Released data and code allow filtering to be revisited: a technical alternative exists, not an immutable language barrier.
counterevidence.implication: Do not recast uneven corpus depth as deliberate exclusion or permanent incapacity.

dedup.reason: Existing records measure downstream retrieval/reranking and evaluation design. FineWeb2 measures upstream corpus curation. Distinct from Common Pile's open-license-first corpus and Comma experiments.

pending_candidates.pending_reason: Reserve outside the four-candidate shortlist. Primary preprint verified, but selected-prompt design limits generalization. Do not integrate automatically.
pending_candidates.date_basis: First preprint submission. Exact experiment dates are not established here; findings describe tested 2025 model versions, not every later DeepSeek service.
pending_candidates.title_ru: R1dacted: избирательные отказы зависят от языка и варианта модели
pending_candidates.title_en: R1dacted: selective refusals vary with language and model variant
pending_candidates.summary_ru: На специально отобранных 10 030 запросах исследователи изучили политически чувствительные отказы и шаблонные ответы DeepSeek-R1, различия между переводами и дистиллированными моделями.
pending_candidates.summary_en: Using 10,030 purpose-selected prompts, researchers studied politically sensitive refusals and template responses in DeepSeek-R1, including differences across translations and distilled models.
pending_candidates.caveat_ru: Выборка отобрана по отказам R1: 100% для английского не является частотой в обычном использовании. Оценка модельная и версионная; сетевую доступность и государственные указания работа не устанавливает.
pending_candidates.caveat_en: Prompts were selected for R1 refusals: 100% in English is not ordinary-use prevalence. Assessment is model-graded and version-specific; network accessibility and state instructions are not established.
pending_candidates.structural_power_inference: Output policy can restrict access even when a model is technically available. This does not prove that every missing source or language gap is intentional censorship.

sources.title: R1dacted: Investigating Local Censorship in DeepSeek's R1 Language Model
sources.verification: Read dataset-selection procedure, language comparison, distilled-model table and QwQ comparison. 'Local censorship' is the authors' model-specific category, not a network-geolocation measurement.

counterevidence.claim_ru: На той же выборке дистиллированные варианты показывали гораздо меньше отказов; QwQ-32B тоже не повторял сильный шаблон R1.
counterevidence.claim_en: Distilled variants showed far fewer refusals on the same prompts; QwQ-32B also lacked R1's strong pattern.
counterevidence.implication: Avoid generalizing from R1 to all Chinese models, all open weights or every deployment.

dedup.reason: The R1 launch is not a refusal audit; network filtering and search-interface citation differences concern other mechanisms. This study adds tested response behavior, not another model release.

rejected_candidates.topic: Pew AI-summary click rates as a new event
rejected_candidates.reason: Already contains 900 adults, 8% versus 15%, citation clicks and observational caveats. No material update established.
KDD publication and later retellings do not make a second experiment; visibility is not traffic or revenue.

rejected_candidates.topic: Cloudflare Pay per Crawl and Microsoft Publisher Content Marketplace launch
rejected_candidates.reason: Launches are already represented. This search did not establish new realized publisher income for those programmes.

rejected_candidates.topic: All Languages Matter and DeLP as fresh multilingual evidence
rejected_candidates.reason: Already include the bias result and benchmark-design counterevidence. Conference or version aliases are not new studies.

rejected_candidates.topic: The old 15% Wikipedia AI Overviews traffic estimate
rejected_candidates.reason: The explicitly withdrawn March version and stale search snippets still circulate. Retained candidate uses October v7's different outcome, comparison groups and estimates; never combine the versions as corroborating studies.

rejected_candidates.topic: Wikipedia's 2025 human-pageview decline as an additional causal AI event
rejected_candidates.reason: Useful first-party measurement caveat, retained beside the referral paper. Bot reclassification and concurrent social-media change prevent treating the aggregate decline as identified AI causation.

rejected_candidates.topic: January 2026 Wikimedia partnerships as exclusive AI training licences
rejected_candidates.reason: The service concerns high-volume API access; content remains free and contracts are nonexclusive under published principles. Kept as one later milestone in the financial family, without invented deal values or signing dates.

rejected_candidates.topic: FineWeb2 launched for the first time in June 2025
rejected_candidates.reason: A dated December 2024 author-team post predates the paper. Candidate is explicitly the June 2025 research publication, not a fabricated dataset-launch event.
Both forum and PDF requests returned browser-verification pages. ArXiv full text and official dataset documentation were accessible; no acceptance-date claim was inferred from a search snippet.

rejected_candidates.topic: Russian TLS recommendations or Chinese regional filtering prove foreign AI search exclusion
rejected_candidates.reason: No matched crawler/retrieval study was established. Certificate trust, connection direction, crawl eligibility, index inclusion and answer refusal cannot be substituted for one another.

rejected_candidates.topic: Additional DeepSeek censorship headlines as independent evidence
rejected_candidates.reason: A separate candidate surfaced, but this pass did not audit its full methods. One fully inspected selective-refusal study with explicit counterexamples was preferred over adding another similarly framed headline for volume.

crosscutting_counterevidence.point: Licensing is not a universal prerequisite for useful model training.
crosscutting_counterevidence.scope_limit: Technical feasibility at a defined scale is distinct from legal permission in a specific jurisdiction; the existing legal record is context, not newly reverified legal advice.

crosscutting_counterevidence.point: A paid delivery service can coexist with open content and nonexclusive access.
crosscutting_counterevidence.scope_limit: A single supplier's finances do not establish an economy-wide sustainable replacement for lost referral traffic.

crosscutting_counterevidence.point: Language coverage, source selection, answer correctness and selective refusal are separate dimensions.
crosscutting_counterevidence.scope_limit: Do not label every absence as censorship; do not label selective political refusal as merely a small corpus without testing it.

final_local_validation.concurrent_change: Another task added the top-level crosscuttingViews configuration during research. Events, claims, claimChecks, arcs and sourceIndex were compared against the initial HEAD snapshot and remain identical. This task did not edit or revert concurrent UI/data changes.
final_local_validation.checks: JSON parsing, date cutoff, required bilingual fields, candidate IDs, all arc/layer/neighbor references and normalized source URL dedup were checked locally. No Atlas build or canonical validation file was written.

verification_limits: Every retained candidate has an opened primary publication or official artifact page with a date basis at or before cutoff. Relative search labels and snippets were not used as event dates.
Research findings are attributed to their authors; experiments, financial audits and product tests were not independently reproduced.
Current pages may contain later edits: inspected revision dates are recorded where available, and living artifact pages do not define event dates.
Source URL aliases and same-family revisions are not independent corroboration. No source after 2026-11-09 was used as evidence.
No new quantified GEO efficacy result or proven Russian/Chinese cross-border AI coverage loss survived the novelty and evidence screen.
Structural-power interpretations are explicitly separated from measured referrals, ratings, corpus statistics, refusal behavior and accounting results.
